full_judgment:
Mohammad Fazlul Karim J: This petition for Leave to Appeal is directed against judgment and order dated 28.05.2007 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 18133 of 2006 making the Rule absolute. 

 2. The facts of the case, in short, are that the informant, Abu Ahmed Siddique, Chairman, Shovan Group of Company Limited, lodged the F. I. R. on 15.05.2006 at about 8:30 P.M. of an occurrence happened in between 8:00 A. M. to 11:00 A. M. of 28.11.2005. The allegation are that accused No. 1, Shahana Khandaker Rumki, daughter-in-law of the informant and wife of his son, Iqbal Yousuf Shovan, marriage was solemnized on 19.11.1999, led the life of questionable limit but the informant did not make any allegation to any one on considering the family status of the informant. In March, 2005, a son was born in the wedlock of the sons of the informant and the accused No. 1. After birth of the son, with the active connivance of accused No. 4, i.e. the mother of the accused No.1, the accused No. 1 become more desperate in living her life. In the month of November, 2005 when the son of the informant was abroad, and on taking advantage of such situating, accused No. 2 to 6 at about 8:00 A.M. of 28.11.2005 forcefully entered into the premises of the informant and by threatening the wife of the informant. Halima Siddique, accused No. 1 took away 300-400 tolas of gold kept in the almirah of her room along with TK.3,00,000.00. It also alleged in the F. I. R. that accused No. 1 also took away other articles in 4/5 suitcase from her room and also taken Toyota Land Cruiser Grand Proud Prado Zeep purchased in the name of accused No. 1 with the money of Shovan Grovan Group of Company, worth of TK. 41,00,000.00. It has been alleged that accused No. 3 and 4 with the help of iron rod and with active participation of accused broke open the door of the garage. The son of the informant, after returning from abroad, made G.D. entry No. 1326 dated 26.12.2005 with the 1 Narayangonj Police Station. The informant further disclosed that he made vigorous search for recovery of the car and other articles taken by the accused No. 1 to 6 and having failed lidged this F. I. R. 

 4. Mr. Abdul Baset Majumder, learned Counsel, appearing for the petitioner submitted that a prima-facie case exists against the accused petitioner; that in a stage of commotion with family affairs the relationship between the accused and the informant became hostile and the accused respondent to have a revenge and to do the mischief to lower the prestige of the informant and his members in the society; that one Abu Ahmed Siddique, son of late Abdul  Rahman, Chairman Shovan Group of Companies Limited filed a complain petition before the Court of magistrate, 1st Class, Narayangonj on 14.05.2006 under Section 448/380/506 of the Penal Code against his daughter-in-law and 5 others; that the Magistrate transmitted the said petition of complaint to the Narayangonj Police Station to treat the same as F. I. R. thus, the case was registered in G. R. The learned Counsel further submitted that soon after marriage, Shahana Khandaker Rumki, the F. I. R. named accused No. 1, used to behave rudely with the complainant, his wife, son and other family members; that in spite of that the complainant's family have endured ill behavior of Shahana Khandaker Rumki for the sake of good reputation of the family, thereafter in March, 2005 a son was born of the womb of accused No. 1, that after the birth of the said son, she became more desperate; that meanwhile, in November, 2005 the complainant's son was abroad for business purpose, the accused No. 2-6 at about 8:00 A. M. on 28.11.2005 forcibly entered into the dwelling house and threatened the family members of the complainant, looted about 300-400 bhori of gold ornaments at TK.3,00,000.00 from the Almirah and with the help of the other accused took the Toyota Land Cruiser Car valued at TK.41,00,000.00 purchased for the F. I. R. named accused No. 1 with the money of Shovan Group of Company Limited.
